purpose: Primary-benchmark pilot of the precommitted first_hit versus defer_ambiguous singleton policy.
input: The preserved canonical whole-block accepted-hit checkpoint from completed job 24240.
control_gate: Reproduce canonical candidate and constraint bytes, native root/pair/confidence/species-tree bytes, and OrthoBench F1 before running the variant.
parameters: CPM 0.1, seed 4, one default profile pass, min_species 1, BLOSUM62, satellite_v2 candidates, high_confidence_pair membership, inferred min_variance species tree, species_overlap rooting, positive_paralogy pairs, legacy support handling. Only singleton tie policy changes at both graph-attachment stages.
verification: Complete input/source/library/runtime pins; graph metadata must record actual policy; full gene-universe and native-content checks; independent OrthoBench score readback.
followup: If the variant passes the development OrthoBench decline screen, prepare corrected QfO and supplementary Three Kingdoms comparisons before considering promotion. A failing primary pilot is an explicit rejected trial, not success or a reason for reference-specific retuning.
limitations: All labels are development-exposed. Selective tree-cache downstream replay is not fresh search or matched fresh timing evidence. The 0.005 screen is not statistical equivalence. Default first_hit stays unchanged.
